runtime: wgpu; generic Lighting3D plus core glTF emissiveFactor/emissiveTexture; per-asset image cache

validation.native_ui: Lighting menu selects night; N toggles both ways while paused; Space resumes animation; night HUD readable

scope: Seeded original room atlases contain standing, seated and reading silhouettes, furniture and blinds. They are texture details, not animated indoor NPCs or accessible interior rooms.
Four building atlases have independent patterns, repeated within each atlas UV grid. Night lighting masks are baked; no random per-frame CPU calculations.
Night uses ambient/directional light and emissive windows/lamps/signs. No local light projection, shadows, bloom or indirect illumination.
Day/night is independent of system UI theme. Imported glTF emissive materials remain supported at default Lighting3D emission strength.
Previous CPU/GPU timing report predates these textures and shader changes. This feature turn validates GPU resource reuse, not a new CPU/GPU performance measurement.
Current worktree and unrelated WIP preserved; not committed.
